reuse.why: Calls the existing building blocks (assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, post/BankSyncError) and shares akahu's balance branch, but the linking and download flows are re-copied rather than factored into a shared provider helper.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkSimpleFinAccount/linkAkahuAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions with only the server URL changed.

placement.why: Each piece sits exactly where the tree puts the equivalent code for the other providers (accounts/app.ts, accounts/sync.ts, server-config.ts, types/models).

scope.why: Only server-side Fintegra support plus a release note; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Follows the established pattern so it is easy to read, but adds a sixth copy of the link flow and a fourth copy of the download flow that must be kept in sync by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing shared helpers; the tree has no shared provider-link or provider-download abstraction to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies are verbatim (linkFintegraAccount vs linkSimpleFinAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions vs downloadAkahuTransactions), not disguised.
